decisions.summary: The devtools option is frozen at config hook time, so any changes to it later are no-ops.
decisions.reason: The devtools value is frozen at the point of configuration, preventing runtime changes to enable/disable or other properties.
decisions.evidence: Devtools option is captured before config hooks, and changes made in config hooks trigger a warning and are ignored.

decisions.summary: Warn users if they attempt to change the devtools option after initial config resolution.

decisions.summary: Suppress the "failed to resolve @vitejs/devtools" error until it is confirmed that devtools is enabled.

decisions.evidence: loadDevToolsIntegrationPlugin and its error logging were completely removed from resolvePlugins.

Sorry I didn't notice that the `devtools` value is frozen at this point. This means any changes to `devtools` option in the config hook will be no-op, not only the enable/disable change.

This description isn't clear about this. I think we should make it clear.
https://github.com/webfansplz/vite/blob/18fa5344891cae946cdf4f9c03be3db510b0989b/docs/config/shared-options.md?plain=1#L630
We probably should emit a warning if it's tried to be changed. Although that requires the knowledge of the `DevToolsConfig` type, which Vite cannot rely on (as devtools may add properties).

nodes.text:
At that point, the `config.devtools` is not resolved (the plugin may enable it), so we don't know if we should inject the devtools.
I guess one way to solve is to suppress the "failed to resolve @vitejs/devtools" error and only emit it after we know that it's enabled.
